entities.summary: Clifford Scott Franklin is an American politician and businessman who has served in the United States House of Representatives since 2021. He represented Florida's 15th congressional district from 2021 to 2023, and has represented Florida's 18th district since 2023. He is a member of the Republican Party. Scott Franklin was a performers & entertainers from Thomaston (b. 1964-08-23, Thomaston). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
